title: ownerOrNotGriefed guard is bypassed via claim() / stake() / unstake(), re-enabling the ES-01 rate-dilution grief

classification.assetImpact: No direct asset theft. Legitimate stakers' intended per-second emission rate is permissionlessly dilutable; value shifts from patient stakers to JIT entrants and the schedule stretches beyond the owner's intent. Quantified prior-report example: ~83% forward-emission cut pinnable indefinitely for ~50k gas per call.
attackPath: 1. Contract live with rewardBudget > 0, windowDuration = 540 days, dispatcher continuously accruing any non-zero mint-debt.
2. Any EOA (no stake, no role) calls NFTStaker.claim().

3. _syncBudget() executes unguarded: _updatePool settles accrual at the OLD rate; dispatcherHook.pull() mints X > 0 phUSD; inflow > 0 triggers the reset branch; windowEnd = now + 540 days; rewardRate = rewardBudget / 46,656,000.
4. user.amount == 0 so pending == 0 and the claim body is a no-op. ownerOrNotGriefed is not on claim() so it never evaluates.
5. Repeat every block to pin the diluted rate indefinitely.
classification.likelihood: high - no special conditions, no role required, no capital required. Gas-cheap permissionless call.
classification.assumptions: Dispatcher accrues any non-zero mint-debt (normal operating condition per spec).

justification: Medium under C4 audit criteria. Assets are not directly stolen or permanently lost - the budgeted rewards still eventually pay out - but the protocol's core function (honoring the owner-configured emission schedule) is permissionlessly impaired by any EOA, and the effect compounds with each call. This is a direct regression of a prior fix (story-003 / ES-01) where the guard was placed on topUp/pullAndRefresh but not on the other entry points that invoke _syncBudget. Fits the Medium bucket: 'protocol function or availability impacted... with stated assumptions.' Not High because there is no direct asset theft or permanent loss - the same nominal budget eventually emits; the realized rate for long-term stakers is diluted as value shifts to late/JIT entrants.
